COMPRESS-110.label: P
COMPRESS-110.reason: This is in the same tar parsing area, so it gives some Regional Context for `TarUtils` and name/path handling. However, COMPRESS-110 is about the ustar `prefix` field for long paths, which is a structural/path-length issue, not character decoding. The current failure is specifically in `TarUtils.parseName` misinterpreting bytes > 127 when converting raw header bytes to characters, so the functional mechanism differs.

COMPRESS-107.label: I
COMPRESS-107.reason: This report concerns tar format detection in `ArchiveStreamFactory` based on magic values, not entry name parsing. It is a different subsystem and a different logic type (format recognition vs. byte-to-string decoding), so it offers little diagnostic value for the current `parseName` encoding bug.

COMPRESS-109.label: I
COMPRESS-109.reason: Although it is still within tar support, Pax header handling is about extended header records and typeflags, not the decoding of file names from raw header bytes. The current bug is localized to `TarUtils.parseName` and character conversion for non-ASCII bytes, so this report is architecturally nearby but mechanistically unrelated.
